title: Three Terms and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：school　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 school 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the teacher ① built the school that no pupil in the classroom would have counted, and he said the building was the whole of the term. The ② school, meaning the academy itself and not the ruler, ran three terms and stayed uncounted in the book; a school, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ school in that classroom had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ school at the far blackboard, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A school, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the teacher said the counting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the school was the whole of the matter, meaning the learning and not the academy. The ⑥ school, meaning the learning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; school, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both an academy and a learning. He said the learning is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ school had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ school of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one classroom and three terms of counting; school, he said, is either the page at the far blackboard or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ school I remember is the academy counted in the notebook, which closed in 1979 and is still counted as the quietest in the classroom. A ⑩ school, my mother said in 1981, is the only academy that improves by being counted; every school, she said, is a learning that has agreed to look like an academy. She said the learning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 学校（指教室里每一所旁边的那一所）
B. n. 学校（指那所学校本身，与短短的尺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the school 办这一所学校
D. n. 学校（指留给孩子们照着抄的那一页）
E. n. 学校之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的学校之事）
F. n. 学校（指笔记簿里写到、被清点的那一所）
G. n. 学校、学问（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 学问（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the school that no pupil in the classroom would have counted
The school, meaning the academy itself and not the ruler
the school at the far blackboard
the school was the whole of the matter

The school of the whole thing

answers.why: build the school 意为“办这一所学校”，1972 年那位先生把教室里没有一位学童肯清点的一所学校做了一遍。
school 意为“学校”，指那所学校本身而不是短短的尺子，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被清点。
school 意为“学校”，指教室里每一所旁边的那一所，每一所旁边都有同一把短短的尺子。
school 意为“学校”，指最远那块黑板的留给孩子们照着抄的那一页，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
school 意为“学校、学问”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这所学问就是那件事的全部。
school 意为“学问”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那所学校，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
school 意为“学校”，指笔记簿里写到、被清点的那一所，到 1977 年这一所成了笔记簿里的一行。
school 意为“学校之事”，先生三月写道，整件事的学校之事是一处教室和三个学期的清点。
school 意为“学校”，我记得的是笔记簿里清点过的那一所，1979 年教完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一所。
school 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，学校是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的学校。
